title: Handoff Event Data
description: CloudEvent data payload for org.governancecommons.agent-matrix.handoff.v1. Emitted when an agent delegates a task to a peer via A2A or a governed handoff envelope.

envelope_id.description: agent-dossier handoff envelope_id for this delegation.

task_id.description: A2A task resource URI for the delegated task.

emitted_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the handoff was transmitted.

handoff_type.description: Protocol used for this handoff: A2A task/send, agent-dossier governed envelope, or escalation handoff.

task_state.description: Task state at handoff time per agent-dossier handoff_protocol.task_state_values.

from_trust_level.description: Trust level of the delegating agent at the time of handoff.

signed.description: True if the handoff envelope carries a valid Ed25519 signature per agent-dossier signature_block.
